# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.75

## Added

- Added configurable Patient Tags under Reference Data. Tags support optional
  groups, colors, notes, active/inactive status, and a default-for-new-patients
  flag.
- Added Patient Tag assignment and filtering in Patients, RX Records, and
  Reports, including multiselect dropdowns and Patient Tags columns in
  patient/RX exports.
- Added seeded City tags for Miami and Tampa. The one-time rollout classifies
  Tampa-address patients as Tampa and defaults remaining patients to Miami,
  with case-insensitive cleanup for duplicate City tag variants.

## Changed

- Updated Patients, RX Records, and Reports filter layouts so tag selectors
  match existing theme sizing/colors and related date filters are visually
  grouped without changing proxy-aware navigation.

## Fixed

- Made the wide role-permission matrix discoverable with a wider editor,
  persistent horizontal scrollbar, explicit left/right controls, and a visible
  hint identifying the driver-permission columns beyond Override.

## Database

- Adds audited migrations `20260904120000-create-patient-tags`,
  `20260904130000-seed-city-patient-tags`, and
  `20260904131500-normalize-city-patient-tags`.

## Safety and audit

- Patient Tags use soft-delete semantics so historical patient assignments are
  preserved.
- No CORS, FortiGate, proxy bootstrap, VPN, cookie, port, or `rxUrl()` behavior
  is changed.
- Production installation must use Project Control option 8 then option 15 from
  the official checksummed GitHub release. Option 16 remains the paired
  application/database emergency rollback path.

## Validation

- Staging and development operator testing confirmed Patient Tags behavior,
  report filters, RX filters, automatic Miami/Tampa city assignment, and layout
  polish.
- Syntax checks passed for the Patient Tags controller and migration files.
- Public JavaScript validation, report-view render validation, staging config
  check, development migration, and login health checks passed before release
  promotion.
